name: Entity facts
notes: Facts every placed entity can hold, declared once as entity:* templates so a level never registers each chest or door (mw-e27.2). The key of one entity's fact is entity:<level>/<entity>.<fact>, e.g. entity:mine/chest-3.looted.

facts.description: The door, gate, chest or hatch has been opened (by hand, key, lockpick, spell or mechanism). Level variants and saves read it to restore the entity open.
The container or corpse has been emptied by the player. Saves and loot tables read it so it stays empty.
